# Binance Futures Upgrades Taker Program (2023-10-31)

Published on 2023-10-18 04:00

Fellow Binancians,

Binance Futures is upgrading the Taker Program. Effective from 2023-10-31 at 00:00 (UTC), eligible users may enjoy a taker fee discount of up to 25% on eligible USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts.

Validity Period: 2023-10-31 00:00 (UTC) to 2024-01-29 23:59 (UTC)

Users who reach a total futures trading volume of 100,000,000 USDT equivalent in the last 30 days, may submit an application for the Taker Program at any time and be assessed in the weekly review of the Taker Program. Users who have applied for the previous Taker Program are not required to resubmit the form, and will be assessed for eligibility automatically. Taker fee discounts will be effective from the following Tuesday after the weekly review. 

The taker fee discount will be based on the user’s weekly taker volume, weekly taker volume share on BTC and ETH pairs, or weekly taker volume share excluding that of BTC and ETH pairs on USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts in the previous week (i.e., Monday at 00:00 UTC to Sunday at 23:59 UTC). Refer to the table below for more details:

Fee Tier  | Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume(USDT Equivalent)  | Or  | Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume Share on BTC and ETH Pairs  | Or  | Weekly USDⓈ-M Futures Taker Volume Share Excluding That of BTC and ETH Pairs  | Taker Fee Discount on USDT-M Perpetual and Delivery Contracts  | Taker Fee Discount on BUSD-M Perpetual Contracts
1  | 250M ≤ X < 500M  | Or  | 0.1% ≤ X < 0.2%  | Or  | 0.1% ≤ X < 0.4%  | 10%  | 5%
2  | 500M ≤ X < 2,500M  | Or  | 0.2% ≤ X < 1%  | Or  | 0.4% ≤ X < 1%  | 15%  | 5%
3  | 2,500M ≤ X < 5,000M  | Or  | 1% ≤ X < 2%  | Or  | 1% ≤ X < 2%  | 20%  | 5%
4  | X ≥ 5,000M  | Or  | X ≥ 2%  | Or  | X ≥ 2%  | 25%  | 5%

Please Note:

  * Users may qualify for a higher fee tier and corresponding taker fee discount when trading eligible USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts, so long as they fulfill the requirements of either the weekly taker volume, weekly taker volume share on BTC and ETH pairs, or weekly taker volume share excluding that of BTC and ETH pairs on USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts for the respective fee tier. 

  * Assuming user A reaches a weekly taker volume of 3,000M USDT equivalent, a 2% taker volume share on BTC and ETH pairs, and a 0.4% taker volume share excluding that of BTC and ETH pairs on USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts from Monday, October 23 at 00:00 (UTC) to Sunday, October 29 at 23:59 (UTC). 

    * User A will qualify for Fee Tier 4 as per the weekly USDⓈ-M futures taker volume share on BTC and ETH pairs. 

    * Therefore, user A will enjoy 25% off taker fees for trades on USDT-margined perpetual and delivery contracts and 5% off taker fees for trades on BUSD-margined perpetual contracts starting from Tuesday, October 31 at 00:00 (UTC) to Monday, November 6 at 23:59 (UTC) (i.e., during the Validity Period).

    * As the taker fee discounts from the upgraded program will be effective from Tuesday, October 31 at 00:00 (UTC) only, users may still enjoy the respective taker fee discounts from the previous Taker Program till 2023-10-30 23:59 (UTC), if they have applied for the program previously and meet the corresponding requirements.

Enroll in the Taker Program Now!

Terms & Conditions:

  * Users’ weekly taker volume, weekly taker volume share on BTC and ETH pairs, and weekly taker volume share excluding that of BTC and ETH pairs on USDⓈ-M perpetual and delivery contracts will be reviewed on a weekly basis (i.e., Monday at 00:00 UTC to Sunday at 23:59 UTC).

  * Weekly USDⓈ-M futures taker volume share on BTC and ETH pairs is defined by the user's weekly taker transaction volume on BTC and ETH pairs divided by the weekly total taker transaction volume on BTC and ETH pairs in the USDⓈ-M market from Monday at 00:00 (UTC) to Sunday at 23:59 (UTC).

  * Weekly USDⓈ-M futures taker volume share excluding that of BTC and ETH pairs is defined by the user's weekly taker transaction volume excluding that of BTC and ETH pairs divided by the weekly total taker transaction volume excluding that of BTC and ETH pairs in the USDⓈ-M market from Monday at 00:00 (UTC) to Sunday at 23:59 (UTC).

  * Any fee tier adjustments will be automatically updated on the following Tuesday at 00:00 (UTC) based on the aforementioned criteria.

  * Users will be removed from the Taker Program if they do not meet the lowest criteria for three consecutive weeks. Binance Futures will not consider reapplications to the Taker Program by these users for the rest of the Validity Period.

  * Taker fee discount will be directly applied to each taker trade.

  * Taker fee discount is applied on top of the BNB fee discount and VIP tier rates.

  * Binance Futures will provide daily and weekly reports to participating users via email.

  * Binance reserves the right to amend or terminate this Program at its sole discretion.

Important announcement about updating the funding rate of U-based perpetual contract

Binance Announcement

--・Verified Binance official account

Dear user:

Binance continuously evaluates its products and services to ensure a quality experience for all users. Based on the results of the recent review, Binance Futures will adjust the funding rate settlement frequency of some U-based perpetual contracts from once every eight hours to every four hours at 16:00 on October 12, 2023 (Eastern Eighth District time) once.

Starting from 16:00 on October 9, 2023 (East Eight District time), the upper and lower limits of the funding rate of some U-standard perpetual contracts will be updated to 3% and -3%. This adjustment applies to all U-margined perpetual contracts with a maximum leverage of 25x or less. If the maximum leverage of a certain contract is reduced to 25x or below, the upper and lower limits of the funding rate of the contract will be automatically updated to 3% and -3% without further announcement.

Binance Futures will continue to review and evaluate funding rates on a regular basis and make necessary adjustments accordingly. If the adjustment involves multiple contracts, Binance will make an announcement at least two weeks in advance. Please note that in situations such as severe market fluctuations, users may not be notified two weeks in advance. The notification period may be shorter in this case, thank you for your understanding!

The rate settlement frequency of the following U-margined perpetual contracts will be adjusted to once every four hours.

  * IMX U-margined Perpetual Contract

  * LPT U-based perpetual contract

  * API3 U-based perpetual contract

  * HIFI U-based perpetual contract

  * NMR U-based perpetual contract

  * TRB U-based perpetual contract

  * BLZ U-based perpetual contract

  * DODO U-based perpetual contract

  * STMX U-based perpetual contract

  * CYBER U-based perpetual contract

  * YGG U-based perpetual contract

  * UNFI U-based perpetual contract

  * FLM U-based perpetual contract

The fund fee payment time for settlement every eight hours is: 08:00 (East Eighth District time), 16:00 (East Eighth District time) and 00:00 the next morning (East Eighth District time). The fund fee payment time for settlement every four hours is: 04:00 (Dongba District time), 08:00 (Dongba District time), 12:00 (Dongba District time), 16:00 (Dongba District time) ), 20:00 (East Eighth District time) and 00:00 the next morning (East Eighth District time).​

Users can view the "Real-time Funding Rate" and "Funding Rate History" pages to view the latest funding rate settlement cycle and funding rate upper/lower limits. API users can query U-based contract funding rate information through the newly added interface (GET /fapi/v1/fundingInfo).​

More information:

  * Introduction to Binance Futures Funding Rates

  * U-margined contracts leverage and margin

Thank you for your support of Binance!

## The maturing derivatives market

A striking feature of the 2020-23 cycle is that futures and options markets have become the go-to place for price exposure and liquidity. 2023 is proving to be an important year in this development, as the options market’s open interest has grown to rival or exceed the futures market in size.

Currently, both have open interest between $16 billion and $20 billion, with Deribit continuing to dominate the options space (90%+). Illustrating the growing interest in Bitcoin from institutional investors, traders and positions often use the options market to deploy more complex trading, risk management and hedging strategies.

ImageFigure 24: Bitcoin: Futures and Options Market Size

Notably, there's also been a shift in dominance within the futures market, with regulated Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) holding more open interest than offshore trading platform Binance for the first time in history. October once again appears to be an important moment in this transition, highlighting the influx of institutional capital.

ImageFigure 25: Futures market dominance (Binance vs CME)

Futures trading volumes for both BTC and ETH increased in October, with a total daily trading volume of $52 billion. Bitcoin contracts account for around 67% of trading volume, while Ethereum contracts account for 33%.

ImageFigure 26: Futures Value: Bitcoin and Ethereum Contracts

Positive carry option returns in the futures market go through three distinct phases over the course of the year, which also tells the story of capital inflows into the sector:

  * From January to August, yields fluctuated around 5%. This is largely in line with short-term Treasury yields, making the product relatively unattractive given the additional risk and complexity of the trade.

  * From August to October, after a sell-off to $26,000, yields were below 3% and volatility was surprisingly low.
